title: Coe
creator: CrossFit
description: Ten rounds of 10 thrusters at 95/65 lb and 10 ring push-ups. Honours U.S. Army Sgt. Keith Adam Coe, killed by an explosive device in Khalis, Iraq, in 2010. One hundred of each; the ring push-ups fade fast, so scale to floor push-ups when the chest stops touching.
